tools.name: Nmap
tools.description: Port scanner, OS detection, service versioning
tools.opsec_considerations: Default scans generate high network noise; customize timing (`-T2`), use decoys, randomize source ports if possible
tools.detection_methods: IDS/IPS signature detection, firewall logs, netflow anomalies

tools.name: Masscan

tools.detection_methods: Massive spike in connection attempts, SYN flood detection

general: 1. **Never use default configurations** — customize all tools

Metasploit: Use staged payloads with custom droppers
Burp Suite: Use Burp Community with custom headers

Network-Level: Large file transfers at odd hours
Unusual protocol usage (DNS tunneling, ICMP tunneling)
Application-Level: SQL injection patterns in web traffic

Avoiding Network Monitoring: Blend traffic patterns with legitimate activity
Avoiding Log Detection: Use techniques that don't generate logs

Empire.notes: Go frameworks are better than PowerShell
